binding_mechanism.globals: Each Lua global is a heap object (LuaUserVar subclass) registered by name via LuaScriptClass::Register_Global_Var (0x247000). Invocation dispatches through vftable slot 10 (offset +0x50): Lua_Call(LuaScriptClass* script, LuaTable* params) -> LuaTable* results. Slot 2 = scalar deleting destructor, slot 4 = per-class type hook.
binding_mechanism.methods: Per wrapper class T, a LuaMemberFunctionWrapper<T> object holding a pointer-to-member (+0x28/+0x30, adjustor at +0x38, flag +0x40) is added to T's member table via LuaUserVar::Register_Member (0x24be40). Its slot 10 (0x244d70) is the shared invoker that unwraps `this` from the Lua userdata and calls the member with (LuaScriptClass*, LuaTable* params). When the registered member is virtual, the stored pointer is an MSVC vcall thunk (`mov rax,[rcx]; jmp [rax+N]`); impl_rva then gives the owner class slot N/8 and `overrides` the derived-class implementations (e.g. TaskForceClass -> Galactic/Space/LandTaskForceClass).
